evidence_items.explanation: The commenter reports cancellation immediately after condemning the new pricing model. This is direct evidence of expressed customer resistance, but the cancellation is unverified and the forum is self-selected.

Anthropic still offered temporary bundled access and stated an aim to restore standard subscription inclusion when capacity allowed. This qualifies a blanket withdrawal reading, but limited subscription inclusion does not establish all-you-can-eat access.

unresolved_gaps: No sufficiently broad contemporaneous comparison establishes provider preferences across the major LLM services.
Customer complaints establish resistance exists, but do not establish its prevalence across the customer population.
The evidence does not cleanly distinguish opposition to metering itself from opposition to higher effective prices.
Temporary bundled access and capacity-dependent plans leave the claimed general withdrawal uncertain.
